app.title: Evolution Population Simulator

topBar.playHint: Let generations pass on their own (Space)
topBar.aiOfflineHint: The simulation needs the local AI engine (Ollama). Open the AI status to see how to start it.

preset-rift-savanna.name: The Rift and the Savanna
preset-rift-savanna.description: A tectonic ridge divides a stable western tropical forest from a drying eastern savanna mosaic.
preset-rift-savanna.scientificHypothesis: Eastern demes under seasonal aridification increase cooperation and migration, triggering Baldwin assimilation or cultural innovation while western forest demes maintain conservative foraging.
preset-rift-savanna.tryThis: Press Play and compare both populations: the drying eastern savanna pushes people to cooperate and migrate, while the forest stays conservative.

preset-darwin-archipelago.name: Darwin's Archipelago
preset-darwin-archipelago.description: Volcanic islands linked by shallow coastal land bridges that periodically flood and emerge with glacial sea-level cycles.
preset-darwin-archipelago.scientificHypothesis: Demes disperse across temporary land bridges during low sea levels and subsequently undergo allopatric speciation when rising seas isolate island populations.
preset-darwin-archipelago.tryThis: Use the Sea tool to flood the land bridges and isolate the islands. After about 10 generations a new species can appear.

preset-finite-island.name: The Finite Island
preset-finite-island.description: A resource-rich but geographically bounded island surrounded by impassable deep ocean.
preset-finite-island.scientificHypothesis: Without communal conservation norms, inter-deme competition and intensive overexploitation degrade carrying capacity K below 60% of Kmax, causing a Tragedy of the Commons.
preset-finite-island.tryThis: Watch the island's habitat health. Without conservation the populations overexploit it; try adding the Communal Conservation Norms trait.

dec-conservative-forage.name: Conservative Foraging
dec-conservative-forage.semanticDescriptor: Sustainable harvesting of renewable local flora and small fauna within natural regeneration limits, preserving carrying capacity.

dec-intensive-overexploit.name: Intensive Overexploitation
dec-intensive-overexploit.semanticDescriptor: Aggressive extraction of maximum immediate biomass to overcome caloric deficits or outcompete rivals, severely degrading habitat carrying capacity.

dec-selective-migration.name: Selective Migration
dec-selective-migration.semanticDescriptor: Coordinated dispersal toward adjacent passable hexagons with higher ecological carrying capacity or lower demographic crowding.

dec-cooperate-store.name: Cooperation & Storage
dec-cooperate-store.semanticDescriptor: Collective resource pooling, seasonal rationing, and mutual protection to buffer environmental fluctuations and droughts.

dec-exchange-symbiosis.name: Exchange / Symbiosis
dec-exchange-symbiosis.semanticDescriptor: Non-violent resource reciprocity and horizontal cultural transmission with cohabiting or neighboring demes.

dec-territorial-dispute.name: Territorial Dispute
dec-territorial-dispute.semanticDescriptor: Hawk-strategy forceful defense or seizure of local carrying capacity against competing demes at high metabolic and mortality risk.

dec-explore-innovate.name: Exploration / Innovation
dec-explore-innovate.semanticDescriptor: High-cost cognitive and behavioral experimentation to discover new ecological niches, tools, or social traditions.

bio-r-strategy.name: r-Strategy (Prolific)
bio-r-strategy.semanticDescriptor: High fecundity, rapid maturation, and low per-offspring energetic investment enabling fast demographic recovery.
bio-r-strategy.affinityCondition: Volatile environments with frequent mortality or newly colonized open habitats.

bio-k-strategy.name: K-Strategy (Longevity & Parental Care)
bio-k-strategy.semanticDescriptor: Extended lifespan, high parental investment, and strong intra-group survival near carrying capacity limits.
bio-k-strategy.affinityCondition: Stable, competitive habitats near carrying capacity K.

bio-digestive-spec.name: Omnivorous Digestive Specialization
bio-digestive-spec.semanticDescriptor: Enzymatic and gut morphology adaptations allowing efficient metabolism of fibrous tubers, seeds, and diverse trophic sources.
bio-digestive-spec.affinityCondition: Resource-scarce savannas, steppes, or seasonal biomes with tough vegetation.

bio-thermal-tolerance.name: Thermal & Hydric Tolerance
bio-thermal-tolerance.semanticDescriptor: Physiological thermoregulation and water-retention mechanisms reducing metabolic stress across extreme climates.
bio-thermal-tolerance.affinityCondition: Arid steppes, freezing tundra, or high-altitude mountain corridors.

bio-encephalization.name: Encephalization (Costly Neural Tissue)
bio-encephalization.semanticDescriptor: Expanded neocortical volume enabling causal reasoning, behavioral plasticity, and cumulative cultural transmission at high caloric cost.
bio-encephalization.affinityCondition: Complex, shifting environments requiring innovation, tool use, or strategic coordination.

bio-social-instinct.name: Instinctive Sociability (Gregariousness)
bio-social-instinct.semanticDescriptor: Neuroendocrine bonding and kin-recognition mechanisms fostering coalition building, shared vigilance, and social learning.
bio-social-instinct.affinityCondition: Multi-deme habitats or patchy savannas where group defense and cooperation increase survival.

cul-fire-processing.name: Fire & Thermal Food Processing
cul-fire-processing.semanticDescriptor: Controlled use of fire for cooking, detoxification, and warmth, lowering digestive overhead while consuming local timber.
cul-fire-processing.affinityCondition: Cold seasons or habitats with raw resources requiring thermal processing.

cul-extraction-tools.name: Specialized Extraction Tools
cul-extraction-tools.semanticDescriptor: Lithic, bone, and wooden implements transmitted across generations to multiply foraging and hunting yields.
cul-extraction-tools.affinityCondition: High-biomass or hard-to-extract ecosystems where technological leverage maximizes caloric intake.

cul-communal-conservation.name: Communal Conservation Norms
cul-communal-conservation.semanticDescriptor: Customary taboos, rotational harvesting, and sanctions against overexploitation that actively preserve and restore carrying capacity K.
cul-communal-conservation.affinityCondition: Bounded islands or fragile ecosystems vulnerable to the Tragedy of the Commons.

cul-interdeme-barter.name: Inter-Deme Barter Networks
cul-interdeme-barter.semanticDescriptor: Ritualized trade protocols and symbolic gift exchange enabling peaceful resource complementarity and horizontal diffusion.
cul-interdeme-barter.affinityCondition: Contact zones with cohabiting or adjacent demes holding complementary traits.

cul-warrior-expansion.name: Warrior / Expansionist Tradition
cul-warrior-expansion.semanticDescriptor: Martial organization, territorial cohesion, and offensive mobilization to displace rival subpopulations.
cul-warrior-expansion.affinityCondition: Crowded territories with severe resource competition between distinct lineages.

tools.label: Tools
tools.energyHint: Every change you make to the environment costs energy. You recover {{regen}} each generation.
tools.observeHint: Click populations and places to learn about them (Esc)
tools.climateHint: Paint a different biome onto the map
tools.climateDescription: Pick a biome, then click or drag over the map to paint it.
tools.terrainDescription: High mountains and the sea are barriers: they can split a population in two.
tools.foodHint: Make a place richer or poorer
tools.foodDescription: More food lets populations grow; less food forces them to adapt or move away.
tools.seaHint: Raise or lower the sea level of the whole world
tools.seaDescription: Affects the whole world at once. Rising seas flood low land and can isolate populations on islands.
tools.notEnoughEnergy: Not enough energy. It recovers every generation.
tools.chronicleHint: Notable events in your world's history
tools.familyTreeHint: Family tree of lineages and species
tools.labHint: Create or edit traits and behaviours

panel.label: Details
panel.noPopulations: All populations are extinct. Start a new world from the world menu.
panel.behaviorHint: Probability of each behaviour this generation, computed by the decision model from the habitat and the population's traits.
panel.addTraitHint: Give this population a trait directly to see how it changes its behaviour.
panel.culturalCapacityRequired: Cultural traditions first need a trait that enables culture (e.g. Encephalization or Instinctive Sociability).
panel.geneticAdaptationHint: Baldwin effect: a behaviour kept for 8 generations under pressure becomes an inherited trait.
panel.culturalInnovationHint: Exploring and innovating builds up until a new tradition is invented (needs cultural capacity).
panel.isolationHint: Allopatric speciation: 10 generations cut off from relatives can give rise to a new species.
panel.healthHint: Carrying capacity K compared with its maximum (K / Kmax). Overexploitation lowers it.

welcome.title: Welcome to Evolution
welcome.tagline: You are nature itself. Shape the land, the climate and the food supply, and watch populations adapt, migrate, split into new species and invent cultures.
